semantic.justification: S3HW1E HTML70 relocates the original SetNumRuleMode0/1/2/4/8 scalar contract to its doc.hxx header responsibility. Existing document re-exports retain the identical runtime enum and all clients keep their import paths. SwDocOptions and WriterEmbeddedFont are unchanged type-only browser construction/package ingress contracts, not claimed native fields/classes/default or ABI parity. No new model, constructor policy or font provider is introduced. Full native document header/default/contracts remain unverified.
